hooks.command: DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; if git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then BRANCH=$(git -C "$DIR" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); CHANGED=$(git -C "$DIR" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"SessionStart\", \"additionalContext\": \"Project status: branch=$BRANCH, $CHANGED uncommitted file(s)\"}}"; else echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"SessionStart\", \"additionalContext\": \"Project status: not a git repo yet\"}}"; fi

DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; INFO=''; if git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then BRANCH=$(git -C "$DIR" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); CHANGED=$(git -C "$DIR" diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -10 | tr '\n' ', '); INFO="branch=$BRANCH modified=[$CHANGED]"; fi; echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"PreCompact\", \"additionalContext\": \"Before compaction: $INFO. Preserve awareness of current task.\"}}"

P=$(basename "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"); osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'display notification "Needs your input" with title (item 1 of argv)' -e 'end run' "$P" 2>/dev/null || notify-send -a 'Claude Code' "$P" 'Needs your input' 2>/dev/null || true

DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; if git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then CHANGED=$(git -C "$DIR" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$CHANGED" -gt 0 ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Uncommitted files: $CHANGED\"}"; fi; fi
